title: yukigamau bar
body:
Yukigamau Bar is a small client-side Minecraft mod that replaces the vanilla heart-based health display with a modern health bar.

Features
- Replaces the vanilla heart health UI with a clean bar-style display
- Displays player health in a more compact and readable way
- Designed to be lightweight and compatible with most mods
- Works on NeoForge and Forge versions

More Details
- If your health is full, your health will be showed with green background.
- If your health is above half, showed with blue background.
- If is below half, showed with red purple.
- If near null,  flashes between purple-red and red.

User Experience
This mod makes it easier to read your health during combat or exploration.
The bar-style display is more compact than vanilla hearts and provides a clearer visual indicator of remaining health.
